name: MSG_KILL
meaning: Only from sender class 0x5f (CannonBall), and not already dead: state 6, returns 1. Sender not NULL-checked. Ignored from every other class.

name: MSG_FREEZE
meaning: Sent by the Wolf to its previous grabber when another object (e.g. Cine_Start) freezes him: wolfFrozen = 0, returns 1.
